identity: concern. Targets: MIM:Acriflavine.

FDA GSRS 1T3A50395T version19 is a mixture with two MUST_BE_PRESENT components, proflavine and methylacridinium chloride; it declares CAS65589-70-0 PRIMARY and CAS8048-52-0 SUPERSEDED. NCI C76253 describes the same mixture and cross-references that UNII. The literal CultureBotHT row separately reports8048-52-0 without registry-currentness evidence. Thus the generic mixture mapping and all three qualified registry/source annotations are supported; neither historical8048 claim is an active identity/xref.

identity: supported. Targets: MIM:Anabasine_Hydrochloride.

CultureBotHT literally pairs Anabasine Hydrochloride with CAS53912-89-3. FDA W4917XZ12G version7 links that CAS to NCIT C216370 and a one-to-one hydrochloride with one absolute stereocenter; NCI provides the exact label and UNII/CAS. PubChem3041330 matches the complete stored formula, stereospecific SMILES and InChI, and GSRS matches the InChI. This supports the explicit monohydrochloride rather than the free base, different salt or racemate.

identity: supported. Targets: MIM:Polymyxin_B.

NCI C61894 defines polymyxin B as the B1/B2 polypeptide mixture and asserts CAS1404-26-8, while its C61895 association is the sulfate. Primary ChEBI8309 separately defines polymyxin B1 with CAS4135-11-9. All272 exact imported source cells say polymyxin b, without selecting B1 or sulfate. The scoped mixture owner and its source-qualified material CAS annotation agree with those facts.

### FC2-XANTHINE-METHOD-001: Xanthine unique-CAS method unsupported

The owner currently declares CAS_RN_LOOKUP, but both primary ChEBI17712 and48517 assert CAS69-89-6. Current MAPPING_SEMANTICS section0 requires this grade to have a unique CAS-to-target resolution; the inspected manual representation review does not prove that uniqueness. This affects current owner method metadata, not the explicitly manual complete mapping row or source-qualified CAS annotation.
